summaries.summary: This slide from Nestlé's 2011 Full Year Results Roadshow, dated February 21st, 2012, presents a bar chart showing 10 years of organic growth and EBIT margin improvement. It highlights that the 10-year annual average Real Internal Growth is 3.6%, while Organic Growth is 6.4%. The chart displays annual growth percentages from 2001 to 2011, with a trend line indicating EBIT margin improvement.
key_facts: Nestlé's 10-year annual average Real Internal Growth is 3.6%
Nestlé's 10-year annual average Organic Growth is 6.4%
The company's tagline is 'Good Food, Good Life'
Data corresponds to published figures, not restated for accounting changes
